caption_draft:
6 free places to find data for your first project.

Kaggle Datasets — https://www.kaggle.com/datasets — Hundreds of thousands of open datasets
data.gov.in — https://www.data.gov.in/metrics — India's government data, open
UCI ML Repository — https://archive.ics.uci.edu — 690 datasets for machine learning
Our World in Data — https://ourworldindata.org/ — 14,040 charts across 126 topics
Hugging Face — https://huggingface.co/datasets — 1M+ datasets
Dataset Search — https://datasetsearch.research.google.com/ — A search engine for datasets

Save this for your first data project. Send it to the friend who keeps asking where to get data.

#datascience #datasets #kaggle #huggingface #machinelearning #firstyear #studentprojects #notyourcollege
